name: Lumo Kodit Oyj
summary: Lumo Kodit Oyj operates as a private housing investment company in Finland. The company rents apartments and offers housing services under the Lumo brand name. It also offers broadband internet connection services, as well as car sharing services. The company was formerly known as Kojamo Oyj and changed its name to Lumo Kodit Oyj in March 2026. Lumo Kodit Oyj was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Helsinki, Finland.
